title: Sound Comparisons
manual_provenance: project fieldwork plus extensive human phonetic analysis/transcription
scope_counts: over 90000 word recordings; over 50000 narrow phonetic transcriptions; about 600 language varieties; 11 language families
license: varies by component/release; preserve per-release license
lineage_decision: Treat component releases (Germanic, Romance, Andes, Mapudungun, Englishes, Celtic, Slavic/Baltic) as one recording lineage with component-specific manifests; do not double-count overlapping site/Zenodo exports
notes: Core-eligible where recordings derive from project fieldwork. Preserve narrow IPA exactly; do not infer segment boundaries because source is word-level unless explicit interval annotation exists. Third-party/legacy components, if encountered, must be isolated to review/excluded.
